mapper.select: SELECT ID, AMOUNT, STORE_ID, CATEGORY_ID, PAYER_ID, PAYMENT_DATE, SPLIT_FLG, REMARKS, RESISTER_DATE FROM TBL_EXPENSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_EXPENSE (AMOUNT, STORE_ID, CATEGORY_ID, PAYER_ID, PAYMENT_DATE, SPLIT_FLG, REMARKS, RESISTER_DATE) VALUES (#{amount}, #{storeId}, #{categoryId}, #{payerId}, #{paymentDate}, #{splitFlg}, #{remarks}, #{resisterDate})
